description: The reported player path, driven through the real T5 'Ere We Go lesson exactly as it is played on itch.io: boot the charge tutorial, click the Boyz row in UNITS THAT CAN CHARGE, then pick the target by CLICKING THE CUSTODIAN GUARD SQUAD ON THE BOARD instead of its name in the right-hand panel. The board click must select the same target the row click would (row highlights, Declare Charge enables), Declare Charge then fires the real DECLARE_CHARGE against the board-picked unit, and the tutorial advances to its 'roll' step — proving the new affordance works under the tutorial's spotlight/allow-list gating too. Also asserts the ELIGIBLE TARGETS hint tells the player the board is clickable.

steps.comment: arm the charger from the unit list (unchanged behaviour); the TARGET below is what this scenario tests
the hint has to TELL the player the board is clickable, or the affordance is undiscoverable
THE ASK: click the Custodian Guard squad ON THE BOARD instead of its row in the right-hand panel
the panel row highlights too — one selection model, two ways in
the real DECLARE_CHARGE went through the tutorial's allow-list gate

steps.script:
var t = PhaseManager.get_current_phase_instance().pending_charges["U_BOYZ_T"]["targets"]
return t.size() == 1 and str(t[0]) == "U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_T"
